# Jefferis Software Solutions

> Bespoke software, websites and advertising for small businesses across the UK. Makers of Relay, the back office that runs itself.

Jefferis Software Solutions is a UK software studio founded by Finlay Jefferis. It builds bespoke business systems (field-service platforms, CRMs, client portals, integrations), fast conversion-focused websites, and full-pipeline ad campaigns — the creative, the landing funnel, and live lead attribution. Its flagship product is Relay, a back-office platform in private preview with real businesses: it reads every email and WhatsApp as it lands, drafts the paperwork, chases the money, and ticks the work off when the reply comes back. Direct client–developer relationship, no agency middlemen.

## Services

- Bespoke Software: Field-service and back-office systems, CRMs, client portals, integrations, and workflow automation
- Relay: Flagship back-office product — unified inbox (email + WhatsApp), quotes and invoices, e-signatures, certificates, diary, money chasing, week planning. In private preview
- Web Design & Development: Mobile-first, performance-optimised sites for small businesses
- Ads: Creatives built from your own site, a custom landing funnel, and live tracking that shows which ad brought each lead

## Website Packages

- Starter (£699 + £21/mo hosting & support): Up to 5 pages, mobile-first, live in under 10 days
- CMS (£1,199 + £21/mo hosting & support): Everything in Starter plus a CMS, blog, and editable pages
- Commerce (£2,000+ + £99/mo hosting & support): Everything in CMS plus e-commerce, Stripe payments, and product management
